decision.decision_ref: FOUNDER DIRECTIVE: H8 GOVERNANCE REMEDIATION (14 Nov 2026), Decision Q-2 - AUTHORISE EXCEPTION PREPARATION ONLY
decision.scope_of_decision: Preparation and qualification only. Landing H8 needs a separate Founder GO naming the commit.

authorises: L4 may treat XP-RULESAPP-FALLS-01 as non-blocking for the MIW H8 Tier A content release only, while RulesApp is not deployed. It does not close, verify, waive or change the RulesApp item; it does not extend, replace or amend GX-S1-RULESAPP-FALLS-20261112; and it authorises no production push.

release.diff_pin_note: The whole difference from production_baseline (S1, a740ed0) to the H8 governance tip: H8 Tier A content (4 new cards, 5 enrichments, the study-layer propagation 766 -> 770, the SQ count), its review fixes (F-1, F-2), the source-registry local_path convention, and this governance change. Every path, its A/M status and its git blob at the release tip. SELF = the two files that cannot pin themselves (this record, pinned by SHA-256 in governance_exceptions.KNOWN_EXCEPTIONS, and that module). No correction record is added or touched: H8 is a content batch, authorised through content_batches (X6).

items.match: Five-yearly: davit falls (wires) must be turned end-for-end or replaced outright
Five-yearly: davit falls (wires) must be turned end-for-end or replaced outright

rulesapp_obligation.owner: RulesApp product owner. No named individual is recorded in the MIW records; the 23 Oct 2026 owner sign-off fields were blank. This exception does not name or replace the owner.
rulesapp_obligation.outstanding: Correct node LSACode-IV-44 (maintenance-guidance) in the RulesApp source store, promote the corrected index, verify the served copy, then close XP-RULESAPP-FALLS-01 as CLOSED_VERIFIED through the RulesApp owner's own process.

deployment_condition.statement: The exception applies only while RulesApp is excluded from the MIW deployment. If RulesApp becomes deployed, the exception does not apply.
evidence_required_at: immediately before any production push (and confirm the Vercel production deployment is the baseline)
after the production deployment of the pushed commit is READY (post-push re-check)
deployment_condition.evidence_scope: The live probes attest to production as it stands at the time of the probe. Because diff_pin makes the candidate's deployment surface byte-identical to the production baseline, they also speak for the candidate.

safeguards: No RulesApp source or index file is changed.
XP-RULESAPP-FALLS-01 is not marked CLOSED or VERIFIED; the record declaring it is unchanged.
The RulesApp owner and the outstanding verification obligation are preserved.
The RulesApp deployment exclusion is not changed.
GX-S1-RULESAPP-FALLS-20261112 is unchanged, keeps its SHA-256 pin and still covers only S1.
No general bypass: L4 still blocks every open cross-product item that no single exception matches and satisfies in full.
Pinned by SHA-256 in the landing gate; linked to CORR-SAFETY-LSA-FALLS-COLDSTART-20261019 and release H8-TIER-A-20261113 only.
Fresh evidence that RulesApp is not deployed is required at qualification, immediately before any production push and after it.
note: Expiry 2026-12-14 is a conservative 30-day limit chosen at preparation and disclosed to the Founder. The exception is honoured only when the landing gate is given a deployment-evidence file produced for the exact tree being landed, through the out-of-repository H8 launcher.
